name: Quiet Step
description: Dampens your footsteps. Everything you do makes half the noise.

name: Ghost Tag
description: Answers the first failing ID scan with a valid-looking record, then holds the lie for a few seconds. It needs a long time to recharge.

name: Signal Lens
description: Shows what robots and cameras can see: their view cones, drawn over the world.

name: Slow Tongue
description: Slows your speech into something officials find reassuring. Opens extra things to say to them.

name: Burst Jammer
description: A pulse that knocks nearby robots and cameras offline for a few seconds. Use it, then get away.

name: Memory Anchor
description: Keeps your notebook from dulling in the Lull. It has no effect anywhere else.
